answer: Fund agent reputation with completed purchases, but cap each reputation gain below the nonrefundable fee burned on that purchase. A nebula image, nectar analysis or jetty inspection earns credit only after escrow releases payment; refunds erase the credit. An attacker buying from its own aliases recovers the sale price but still loses the burned fee on every wash trade. Splitting into 1,000 sellers cannot create free reputation. This prices reputation farming rather than proving uniqueness; buyers still need independent quality checks.
